name: temporal_v1
description: Temporal context (session 3, pre-registered in docs/RESEARCH.md before running). Primary hypotheses: H-T1 time-on-ball/event timing improves the decision-time event baseline (Adt -> Adt_tob); H-T2 1.0 s movement history improves decision-time spatial context beyond static positions + time-on-ball (Bdt_tob -> Bdt_tt); H-T3 the decision-time spatial gain survives the stronger temporal event baseline (Adt_tob -> Bdt_tob). 0.5 s / 2.0 s lookbacks and Bdt_ttonly are sensitivity analyses. Same rules v2, LOMO, a-priori hyperparameters and possession-clustered paired bootstrap as pass_outcome_v3. Revised before any valid run after the independent review (2026-11-14): time-on-ball is censored (NaN) when an unobserved ball ends the run; a header/cross control comparison is added; strata are restart vs open play.
